title: JS Lab: Make It Interactive
description: Add two interactive features to your page: a dark mode toggle (button that adds/removes a class on body), and a contact form that validates inputs and shows a success message on submit.

hints: Use document.getElementById('dark-toggle').addEventListener('click', ...) to wire up the toggle button
document.body.classList.toggle('dark') adds the class if missing, removes it if present
Always call event.preventDefault() first inside a submit handler to stop the page reloading
Read name with document.getElementById('name').value.trim() — check it's not empty before showing success
Set document.getElementById('success').style.display = 'block' to reveal the success message

tests.message: Use addEventListener to attach event handlers
Use classList.toggle to switch the dark mode class
Call event.preventDefault() in your submit handler
Listen for the submit event on the form
Show the #success element when the form is valid
